question: In the phrase "suspicious upfront payments" the word "suspicious" is closest in meaning to ______
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. doubtful or questionable.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"suspicious"** means:

 
 
• Inclined to suspect, especially inclined to suspect wrongdoing; questionable; seeming to be dishonest or false. (संदिग्ध)
 
 
 
• In the context of the phrase "suspicious upfront payments," the word "suspicious" implies that the payments are doubtful or questionable and may not be legitimate.
 
• **Example:** The suspicious behavior of the new employee raised concerns among the team.

Therefore, the word "suspicious" is closest in meaning to: **doubtful or questionable.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Trustworthy and clear** (विश्वसनीय और स्पष्ट): Reliable and easy to understand.

 
 
• **Example:** Her trustworthy and clear explanation helped everyone understand the procedure.
 
 
 
• **Common and usual** (सामान्य और प्रचलित): Frequently occurring and typical.
 
 
• **Example:** It is common and usual to see traffic jams during rush hour.
 
 
 
• **Fast and efficient** (तेज और कुशल): Quick and effective in operation.
 
 
• **Example:** The new software is fast and efficient, improving productivity significantly.
 
 

209:Tbd4,
The correct answer is Option 2
